data.long_meaning: The name Jishnu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jishnu', which means 'God of Calm and Peace'. It is a popular name among Hindus and is considered to be a powerful and spiritual name. The name Jishnu carries the meaning “God of Calm and Peace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jishnu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of calm and peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jishnu is a divine name that represents calmness, peace, and knowledge. It is believed to bring inner peace and tranquility to the person bearing this name. It is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and is known for his calming influence.
data.etymology: Jishnu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Calm and Peace.”
